blurb: Midwest Freefall offers skydiving experiences including tandem skydiving for first-timers, an Accelerated Freefall Program (AFF) to achieve solo skydiving license, and facilities for licensed skydivers. Located 40 miles north of Detroit, it is the closest skydiving center to the Motor City. The dropzone features a Blackhawk Caravan aircraft, carpeted packing area, and private airstrip.
